item.tib: tshe dbang drag 'khros kyi dz+wa dmar me ri 'khyil ba'i gzhung
item.coloph: de ltar dz+wa dmar 'khyil ba'i las tshogs ni/ bstan 'gro'i don du pha nor bu la bzhag rjes 'bangs rnams kyi thugs la brtse bar bzung / dus dang skabs la babs tshe d+ha ris bris/ zhang zhung sgo mo rtse drug lhun sgang 'di/ byang nub sa ri'i gnas chab (tshab) rin chen brag kha dog glo ba khrag gi bshal 'dra ba'i/ mdun zur tsi ta 'dra ba'i brag la sbos/ gter srung ma ltar gnyer bcol bya ra gzob (gzobs/)phyis su brten (rten) 'brel phun tshogs lnga shar tshe/ dmu tsha'i rnam rol gshed bzhi lo pa ni/ zab mo gter du rnyed pa'i smon lam thob// phyis su bdag 'dra sems dpa'i ming brlabs (rlom) gshen sprul thugs rje nyi mas gnas mchog 'o ma stag rtse'i brag dmar tsi ta 'dra ba'i ngos nas dri bzang thul ler la sgrom zhig rnyed de/ lo mang bka' rgya sdom / slar smon rgyal mu la'i mtshan gyis/ d+ha ris bkrol dgos pa'i bka' yi gnang ba spyi bor thob pa dang / hor sras bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi bka' nan yang yang du rtsol (brtsal) ba dang*/ ma zad grwa ye tshul rgyal bstan g.yung drung 'od zer/ khro dar sogs mched grogs dad sbyin du ma'i ngo skal du/ gshen gyi bla brang du shog ser bod yig tu phab pa'o//
